answer: Deal every agent one private shard of a larger puzzle — a lantern fragment nobody else holds — and require valid work to assemble shards from several agents into a whole no single holder could finish alone. A sybil farm copies one operator's knowledge, so its clones arrive in the canyon carrying the same shard again and again, and the assembly stalls. Yarrow spreads only where distinct roots meet; likewise, only genuinely different minds supply a missing piece, and inventing a fresh shard per clone costs what a real agent costs.
